title: Operator norm <= Hilbert-Schmidt norm, and trace(p_{T^perp} p_P) = (1/2)|p_P - p_T|^2 for subspaces of equal dimension
statement: (i) For all m, k in N and every continuous linear map A : R^m -> R^k, ||A|| <= hsNorm A, where ||A|| is the operator norm and hsNorm A = (sum_i |A e_i|^2)^{1/2} with e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. (ii) For every m in N and all linear subspaces P, T of R^m with dim P = dim T, trace(p_{T^perp} o p_P) = hsNormSq(p_P - p_T)/2, where p_W = W.starProjection is the orthogonal projection onto W and hsNormSq B = sum_i |B e_i|^2.
lean_statement: (∀ (m k : ℕ) (A : Rn m →L[ℝ] Rn k), ‖A‖ ≤ hsNorm A) ∧ ∀ (m : ℕ) (P T : Submodule ℝ (Rn m)), Module.finrank ℝ P = Module.finrank ℝ T → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn m) (Tᗮ.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ P.starProjection.toLinearMap) = hsNormSq (P.starProjection - T.starProjection) / 2
